title: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.28622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial intelligence has recently been assessed through generative tasks such as spatially grounded image editing, yet language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial multi-view observations remains underexplored. We introduce MindView, a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence with 1,500 samples from 513 scenes across three indoor datasets. Its seven tasks form two families: geometry-dominant tasks specify changes in camera position and orientation, while semantics-dominant tasks require inferring target viewpoints by grounding referred objects and interpreting spatial relations and reference-frame cues. Evaluation of eleven generators reveals substantial room for improvement on MindView. A paired context analysis further shows that all eleven generators obtain lower overall scores under the expanded context setting. translated_title: MindView：生成式多视角空间智能基准测试
translated_abstract: 空间智能近来通过空间定位图像编辑等生成式任务进行评估，然而基于语言引导、从部分多视角观察生成空间一致视角的研究仍然不足。我们提出了MindView，一个用于生成式多视角空间智能的基准，包含来自三个室内数据集中513个场景的1,500个样本。其七项任务分为两大类：几何主导任务指定相机位置和朝向的变化，而语义主导任务则需要通过定位所指对象、解释空间关系和参考框架线索来推断目标视角。对十一个生成模型的评估表明，它们在MindView上仍有很大提升空间。配对上下文分析进一步显示，在扩展上下文设置下，所有十一个生成模型的整体得分都更低。这些发现促使我们研究任务特定的监督能否……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了MindView基准，通过几何主导与语义主导两类共七项生成任务来评估多视角空间智能，发现十一个现有生成模型表现均有较大提升空间，且在扩展上下文设置下得分更低。
en_tdlr: MindView is introduced as a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence, featuring seven geometry- and semantics-dominant tasks across 1,500 samples, revealing substantial room for improvement among eleven evaluated generators.
